title: mercurialis annua subvar. euannua
intro: Mercurialis annua subvar. euannua, commonly known as annual mercury, is a perennial plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been utilized in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mercurialis annua subvar. euannua include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal effects, making it useful in treating various conditions such as skin irritations and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
